blockingIssues.description: The scope-drift issue is fixed, but transcription runner drain remains incomplete: `stopAudioTranscriptionRunner({ drain: true })` still awaits only a snapshot of `activeJobs` and does not await an already-running `runAudioTranscriptionTick()`. A tick in progress can still claim/start new jobs after stop returns, so teardown is not yet guaranteed quiescent before Mongo disconnect.

rejectedObservations.observation: Procedure-adherence reporting appears optimistic in runtime-worker handoffs when transcript skeletons do not show all mandatory reads but `followedProcedure=true` is still reported.
